teaser: You are halfway out the door, coat half on, when you turn back to finish a sentence you started with someone days ago. That pause is the whole crossing: a life path 5, built for movement, set against an INFJ, built for meaning. The 5 would leave a conversation unfinished and pick it up later, somewhere else, with someone new. The INFJ cannot leave it unfinished at all. What is particular here is a hunger for new ground that keeps stopping, mid-stride, to make sure the old ground is settled first.
